type.description: Defines the scheduling of the `operating mode`.

level.description: Level at which the `operating mode` would be defined.

locationId.description: Unique identifier of the location. Mandatory if level is `LOCATION`.

sameHoursDaily.description: `Operating mode` schedule for same hours daily. Mandatory if type is `SAME_HOURS_DAILY`.

differentHoursDaily.description: `Operating mode` schedule for different hours daily. Mandatory if type is `DIFFERENT_HOURS_DAILY`.

holidays.description: `Operating mode` holidays. Mandatory if type is `HOLIDAY`.

callForwarding.description: Call forwarding settings for an `operating mode`.
